title.narrative: Strengthened labour administration and promotion of tripartism and social dialogue

description.narrative: Tripartite and bipartite social dialogue are still in a relatively early stage of development in the Maldives in institutional, capacity and cultural terms. Key social tripartite dialogue mechanisms currently in place are the Tripartite Labour Advisory Board (TLAB) established under Industrial Relations Act (August 2024), the DWCP Task Force established under TLAB in November 2024, the tripartite Salary and Wage Advisory Board (SAWAB), and the newly established Industrial Dispute Resolution Division and Industrial Dispute Resolution Panel under the Employment Tribunal. The CPO also supports to strengthen the labour migration governance framework by addressing issues such as excessive recruitment fees and related costs, deception about working and living conditions, a lack of pre-departure and post arrival employment orientation/training and ensuring the provision of decent housing. Also this CPO supports to develop a Labour Market Information System (LMIS) which is responsive to key SDG disaggregation requirements (e.g. sex, migrants, disability and other vulnerable groups) in collaboration with Ministry of HIgher Education, Labour and Skills Development
